name: _fake_quantize_learnable_per_tensor_affine_backward
description: Representative schema: aten::_fake_quantize_learnable_per_tensor_affine_backward(Tensor grad, Tensor self, Tensor scale, Tensor zero_point, int quant_min, int quant_max, float grad_factor=1.0) -> (Tensor, Tensor, Tensor). Computes straight-through input gradients and reduced learnable scale and zero-point gradients. Tests cover symmetric and asymmetric ranges, bfloat16 where supported, saturation, grad-factor scaling, empty inputs, output metadata, input preservation, and invalid non-floating inputs.
